title: Man Realizes His 9-Year-Old Niece Was Murdered
description:

Police took Tyshael Martin, 34, and Lojuan Sessions into custody after Lojuan’s daughter Jamaria Sessions, 9, was found unresponsive in the couple’s shared home. Detectives spent countless hours reviewing home security footage that allegedly revealed Tyshael's involvement. Get the details on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
